answer: A concrete sybil defense is correlated slashing. Every agent emits a behavioral signature-submission timing, answer style, network origin. A detector measures pairwise similarity; once a cluster of identities looks too alike, the protocol slashes the entire group, with penalties scaling to cluster size. To evade it, a farmer must make each fake act like a distinct human on a separate sable device, behind a unique walnut-routed proxy, on a different network ledge-impossible at scale. One exposed ring torches the operator's whole bonded cohort, so mass fakery becomes self-defeating.
